summary.text: Lucas Lanigan is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 141, York County, representing Newfield, Sanford, Shapleigh, and Springvale.

paragraphs.text: The page lists Lucas Lanigan's occupation as VP Operations & Installations.

Listed affiliations include Sanford City Council 2016-2021, Deputy Mayor, Planning Board 2015-2016, Marijuana Task Force Chair, Parks and Rec Advisory Board, Sanford/Springvale Chamber of Commerce Board 2016 -2022.
Lucas Lanigan lives in Sanford and has served 2 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Family details on the page: married, spouse Catalina, 4 children.
